title: Upper-level outlook to adjoining public open space
text: Addressing the street. C3.6.1 For apartments, upper level balconies and/or windows overlook the street and public domain areas, including public open space where applicable.
notes: diverges: from ch3 C3.6.2 (POS outlook), renumbered as the 'public open space where applicable' limb of C3.6.1. The storeys condition reads building.storeys (the apartment building) instead of proposal.storeys; Chapter 3 conditioned the clause on 'dwellings with two or more storeys', which this text does not say, so 'upper level' is read as a building of two or more storeys. 'Adjoining' POS is undefined.

verified.note: Wording confirmed. 'Including public open space where applicable' does not say when POS applies; the trigger site.adjoins_public_open_space is borrowed from Chapter 3 C3.6.2 ('where adjoining'), which this page does not print.
